input.quote: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman.
input.rationale: Section 17(b) does give us a convenience right and Garman has no reciprocal at-will right (Garman may terminate only for insolvency or uncured material default under 17(c)), so the direction of the clause is acceptable. However, the notice period is 90 days (fallback, not preferred 30 days) and, unlike the default/rejection remedies in Sections 8 and 17(c), the clause is silent on any refund of prepaid fees, so we could pay for licence and maintenance periods we no longer use. Redline shortens notice to 30 days and adds a no-penalty, pro-rata refund of prepaid fees; 60 days' notice is an acceptable fallback if the refund is retained.

proposal.summary: Shorten Sparkling's convenience termination notice to 30 days and add pro-rata refund of prepaid fees
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have moved our convenience termination notice from ninety (90) to thirty (30) days and added a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, consistent with our position that the customer may exit on 30 days' notice without penalty. If Garman needs a longer wind-down, we can live with 60 days' notice provided the refund of prepaid fees remains.

ops.oldText: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman. If Sparkling terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 17(b), Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
ops.newText: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, at any time for convenience upon thirty (30) calendar days written notice to Garman. If Sparkling terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 17(b), Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the thirty (30) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes. No termination charge, penalty or early termination fee shall be payable in respect of such termination, and Garman shall refund to Sparkling, within thirty (30) calendar days of the effective date of termination, any fees prepaid in respect of any period after that date.
